source_refs.note: 1- Somatic Nervous System: a main subheading of 15.5.3 Divisions of the PNS, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 42-42.

blocks.text: It consists of those motor neurons of spinal and cranial nerves which control skeletal muscles. The somatic system is voluntary. It means that skeletal muscles can be moved at will. For reflex action, the somatic system operates without conscious control.
